name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor with AI Writer, Auto Internal Linker, Broken Link Checker & Find & Replace
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost is the industry-leading AI-driven productivity suite for professional bloggers, SEO agencies, and content creators. It transforms the WordPress Classic Editor (TinyMCE) into a high-octane content machine, eliminating the need for multiple heavy plugins.

Built by DominoPress, this toolkit provides a distraction-free environment where AI does the heavy lifting—from generating full SEO-optimized articles to advanced semantic internal linking. Stop switching between tabs; bring the power of GPT-4 directly to your editor.

💎 DominoPost PRO: The AI Evolution

Upgrade your content game with the DominoPost PRO Addon, featuring our most advanced automation engines:

  • ⚡ AI Smart Internal Interlinker: Automatically scans your site and inserts high-relevance internal links with perfect anchor text. Double your page views and boost SEO in seconds.
  • 🌐 Smart AI External Link Placement: Paste any external URL and let the AI find the perfect context-aware spot to insert it naturally.
  • ✨ AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand): Select any text and instantly paraphrase it with 4 professional tones (Friendly, Creative, Professional, Concise).
  • ❓ AI FAQ Schema Generator: Generate beautiful FAQ blocks with automated JSON-LD Schema to dominate Google’s “People Also Ask” sections.
  • ✍️ 1-Click AI Grammar Fixer: Instantly detect and fix grammatical errors across your entire post with a single click.
  • 🎯 Focus Keyword Optimization: Automatically optimize your article’s keyword density and placement for maximum search visibility.
  • 📦 Premium AI Interface: Experience the “Scroll & Review” bar to verify AI links before publishing, plus our signature tech-inspired scanning animations.

🚀 DominoPost FREE: Essential Productivity Suite

Get started with our lightweight, high-performance toolkit for every writer:

  • ⚡ Pro Table of Contents (TOC): 4 stunning styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed) with smooth-scrolling and live preview. Superior SEO and UX out of the box.
  • 🔍 Google Keyword Research: Real-time related keyword suggestions tool directly in the AI Writer modal to find high-intent search queries.
  • 🕵️‍♂️ Site-Wide Broken Link Checker: Now seamlessly located inside the Tools Menu for real-time site audit.
  • ✍️ AI Content Writer (Standard): Generate SEO-optimized lists, headings, and outlines from simple keywords. Support for 50+ languages.
  • 🔍 Bulk Title Editor Suite: Effortlessly perform title suffix additions, keyword find-and-replacements, and manual overrides in bulk.
  • 🔄 Find & Replace: Quickly find and replace text across your content directly inside the classic editor.
  • 🔗 Smart Related Posts: Keep readers engaged with beautiful, context-aware related post suggestions.
  • 📅 Content Update Reminders: Never let your content go stale with automated update notifications for older posts.
  • 😀 Emoji Picker & Table Builder: Add visual flair and structured data to your posts directly from the editor toolbar.
  • 📎 CTA & Copy Code Buttons: Professional one-click buttons for code snippets and call-to-action blocks to boost conversions.
  • 📊 SEO Post Analysis: Real-time stats, word count, reading time, and keyword density tracking in your sidebar.
  • 📝 Case Converter: Instantly fix capitalization (Title Case, Sentence Case, UPPERCASE) in one click.

Why Choose DominoPress?

  1. Lightweight & Fast: Optimized code with Zero Bloat. Doesn’t slow down your site or dashboard.
  2. SEO-First Design: Every feature is built to help you rank higher on Google Search.
  3. Seamless Integration: Built natively for the WordPress Classic Editor for the fastest writing experience possible.

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress Content Creation Smarter, Faster, and more Human.
Visit us: https://dominopress.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost-advanced-post-editor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. (Optional) Install the DominoPost PRO Addon to unlock the advanced AI automation suite.
  4. Visit DominoPost Settings to configure your API key and default styles.
  5. Start creating world-class content!
sections.faq:
Does it support OpenAI and LongCat AI?

Yes! We support any OpenAI-compatible API key. Simply enter your key in the settings.

Is the Table of Contents SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Our TOC follows semantic HTML structures and uses clean IDs for perfect Google crawling.

Does the PRO Addon require the Free version?

Yes, the PRO Addon is a lightweight enhancement that plugs into the robust DominoPost core. Use them together for the ultimate experience.
sections.changelog:
2.9.0

  • NEW: Integrated a native Google Keyword Research tool in the AI Writer modal to easily find high-value related keywords.
  • NEW: Complete “Classic Warm” theme upgrade for Table of Contents, including header section signs (§) and nested counters (Roman numerals for H2, alphabetical letters for H3).
  • Tweak: Clarified OpenRouter configuration label to “OpenRouter (FREE)”.
  • Fixed: Resolved Table of Contents formatting issues, including layout alignment, self-inclusion of its own title, and bullet point wrapping.

2.8.3

  • Fixed: 504 Gateway Time-out error on live servers during long OpenRouter AI generations. Integrated SSE stream processing to keep web servers alive.
  • Tweak: Automatically lock generator buttons for Free users after reaching the 3 daily limits.
  • Tweak: Added dynamic referral parameters to all upgrade links for better tracking.

2.8.0

  • NEW: Moved site-wide Broken Link Checker from settings page into a dedicated tab inside the Tools Menu.
  • NEW: Integrated premium Bulk Title Editor Suite.
  • NEW: Added AI FAQ Schema Customization options in the settings page.
  • IMPROVED: Absolute-positioned Title Case Fixer “Aa” button inside the post title input field (Yoast/Rank Math style), resolving restricted click areas on top header elements.
  • FIXED: Restored complete clickability of the standard WordPress “Add Post” header actions and titles.
  • IMPROVED: Synchronized AI template blueprints across Gutenberg React modal, Classic Editor React modal, and Classic PHP-rendered metaboxes.
  • IMPROVED: Automated post title extraction and body purging of duplicate H1/H2 tags on AI article insertion.

2.7.0

  • NEW: Comprehensive Content Analytics Dashboard to track views, unique visitors, time on page, and bounce rates.
  • NEW: AI Content Generator – Easily generate AI content directly via a seamless modal in the post editor.
  • NEW: Advanced Engagement Tracking Engine with real-time Javascript beacons.
  • NEW: Underperforming Posts Detection – Automatically flag posts with high bounce rates, low time on page, or missing internal links.
  • NEW: Traffic Trend Charts, Device & Audience Split, and “Most Viewed Posts” leaderboard.

2.6.0

  • NEW: Official Launch of the DominoPost PRO Addon Architecture.
  • NEW: Premium AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand) with 4 custom tones.
  • NEW: AI FAQ Schema Generator with automated JSON-LD output.
  • NEW: Permanent Toolbar Visibility for all premium tools with “PRO Preview” interactive modals.
  • Updated: Official DominoPress rebranding and new support URLs.
  • Improved: Major CSS overhaul for all editor popups and modals for premium pixel-perfect finish.
  • Fixed: Duplication issues when PRO and Core are active simultaneously.

2.5.0

  • NEW: AI-Powered Auto Internal Linking (PRO).
  • NEW: Smart AI External Link placement with context analysis (PRO).
  • NEW: “Scroll & Review” Bar for premium link verification.
  • Improved: Enhanced AI loading overlay with high-tech animations.

2.4.0

  • Fixed: Editor and Author roles can now properly access DominoPost tools.
  • Fixed: Resolved issue where the TinyMCE visual editor would sometimes crash into the “Text” tab for non-admin users.

2.3.2

  • Fixed: Stop AI from incorrectly altering valid proper nouns and foreign language spellings.
  • Improved: AI Writer prompt logic for ‘Keyword Clustering’ mode to build strong pillar pages.
  • Improved: Better SEO tuning for Bulk Mode.

2.3.1

  • Fixed: Improved API response handling and implemented a smart retry mechanism.
  • Improved: AI Writer configuration UI and added a direct setting link in the plugins list.

2.3.0

  • New: Added support for AI Provider selection (LongCat vs OpenAI).
  • New: Added optional “Custom Instructions” field for AI generation.
  • Improved: AI now automatically detects and fixes spelling mistakes in keywords.
  • Improved: Better error handling and timeout prevention for long articles.

2.2.2

  • FIX: Fixed AI Writer timeouts on slower servers (increased execution limit).
  • FIX: Fixed “Empty Response” error for Bengali/non-English languages.
  • FIX: Fixed Word Count accuracy for Unicode/Bengali scripts.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Enhanced AI prompts for more natural, human-like language generation.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Clarified API configuration instructions.

2.2.1

  • FIX: Fixed readme.txt tags and description length compliance warnings.
  • FIX: Fixed Table of Contents including “More Articles” header.

2.2.0

  • NEW: AI Writer – Powerful SEO content generator with Bulk and Clustering modes.
  • NEW: Settings Menu – Renamed specific submenu to “Settings” for clarity.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Refined UI and prompts for better human-like writing.

2.1.0

  • NEW: Related Posts – Simple numbered list of related content.
  • NEW: Update Reminders – Dashboard notifications with action buttons.
  • NEW: Manual Related Posts selection via meta box.
  • NEW: “Notified” and “Remind 2 days later” buttons for reminders.
  • NEW: “Last Updated” display option.
  • NEW: Download button “Open in new tab” option.
  • IMPROVED: Emoji Picker – Curated 75 most-used emojis for bloggers.
  • IMPROVED: Download buttons – Auto-add https:// to URLs.
  • IMPROVED: TOC smooth scrolling.
  • IMPROVED: Title Case Fixer positioning and visibility.
  • IMPROVED: Related Posts design – clean numbered list.
  • IMPROVED: Overall UI/UX enhancements.
  • REMOVED: Email notifications (replaced with dashboard notifications).
  • SECURITY: Added ABSPATH checks to all class files.
  • Version bump to 2.0.0 for major feature additions.

1.2.1 – 2024-11-26

  • Fixed TOC emoji encoding issue.
  • Added modern TOC styling with 4 variations.
  • Improved settings page organization.
  • Bug fixes and performance improvements.

1.2.0 – 2024-11-25

  • Added Table of Contents feature.
  • Added Content Analyzer.
